# Blocking pinned AGP ordering and parser finding

Read-only report. No Rust/JVM/Gradle/app execution or product change was made for this finding. The existing successful 202-test run included a new test expecting the wrong dev ordering; its original log and source remain retained.

Pinned base revision `4a5d2ec9571e2021fc9a4621e24a195f966ee6dd`, `sdk-common/src/main/java/com/android/ide/common/repository/AgpVersion.kt`, SHA `e689e8d93c9b78f77bcfb94c41b97c5a0bb825537e576e84a30f5ffbbed0edfb`: lines36–41 declare ALPHA, BETA, RC, DEV, NONE in order; lines109–117 compare major/minor/micro then enum ordinal then preview number.

Pinned idea revision `a84efec3ba9542d9bfa1255103f0dc94833a3796`, `BasicModules.kt`, SHA `eddaa76c66ff68b5b13fd625fdc8e44adf422fe3ce2a220c3af5bc27bf6293ed`: line85 selects `8.2.0-alpha07` for HAS_GENERATED_CLASSPATHS. Lines130–138 enable producer>=8.9 OR AGP at least that threshold.

Current `generated_artifacts.rs`, SHA `5264e4c00d8958a4aaee250c7d924ae89e4665f778b893156442f6af3ed52be0`: line221 places dev at rank0, below alpha1. With producer8.8 and AGP8.2.0-dev, lines184–189 therefore return false. Pinned policy returns true because DEV follows RC and ALPHA. Current new `tests/generated_artifacts.rs`, SHA `9900069b1a993875795c4be1feadf5f4a8da2a5750f486beb4596ae6b45efbf1`, line148 explicitly expects false. This is a wrong newly authored expectation, not an original upstream assertion. Correct it to true while preserving the old assertion/source/log in history. No claim of an actual SDK8.2-dev capture follows from this static counterexample.

The parser is also broader than pinned production: modern alpha7, alpha007, leading-zero numeric components, numeric components above Int.MAX_VALUE, and padded historical3.0/3.1.0-beta previews are accepted by current Rust and rejected by pinned parsing. The exact literal format rule also rejects padded3.1.1-alpha01. Those are invalid spellings rather than separate valid supported versions. `8.2.0-dev` is valid under both implementations and is the concrete supported-version ordering discrepancy. The five retained actual SDK probes used stable9.4.0; they do not validate these boundaries.

Root owns correcting current V2 integration, preserving history and rerunning affected reviews/gates. This parallel-policy worktree will not edit that old module or tests. Exact paths, hashes, line references and input distinctions are in the adjacent JSON report.
